actual_checks: Read exact arbitrary-binary-basis omega(n) circuit target, both full earlier bodies and complete current report. Independently verified the Khrapchenko protocol partition: Bob chooses at OR,Alice at AND; each leaf rectangle has a fixed differing coordinate and its distance-one edges form a matching. Cauchy-Schwarz yields |E|^2/(|A||B|). Parity yields n^2 leaves, attained by balanced XOR expansion at powers of two.

Checked n-1 arbitrary-binary-gate parity upper bound and dependency graph lower bound: all n essential inputs connect to the output, so n+s-1<=2s. n=1 has zero gates. Fanout/basis changes prevent the formula inference. Source-only zero executions.
